name: inthepond-skills
description: Skills that give creativity and thinking back to the person using the model, not productivity.

plugins.name: gnose
plugins.description: An introspection layer between you and the model: shows how an LLM reads your prompt, lets you correct the reading in plain language, and reshapes the prompt to what you meant. No scores, no conclusions.

plugins.name: samesame
plugins.description: Same same, but different: carry a UI through a port or a redesign without losing what matters. Builds a local ground-truth harness (screenshots + computed styles), writes a plan you approve once, then converges in checkpointed, resumable increments. Nothing leaves your machine.

plugins.name: notjunior
plugins.description: Know why, not just what: a senior engineer beside you with your codebase open. Explains how code reaches production, why the architecture has its shape, what each technology is for, how features run and incidents are handled — every claim cited or labelled — then has you explain it back. Rehearses interviews; never answers live ones. Its mod offers an explain-back check after Claude changes files, and before they ship.
